I didn't ask you any questions. I assumed a photoreal style, a 2026 office in Yerevan, and prompts that work with any model, with settings for Midjourney v7, Flux/SDXL and GPT-Image/Gemini.

Generate them in this order: first the face close-up (#3), then the turnaround (#1), the expression sheet (#2) and the props sheet (#4). After that, use the close-up as the face reference for every scene shot.

The same content is saved as `narine_character_sheet.md` in the working directory.

## FINAL

**A. Identity block (paste into every prompt, word for word, and never edit it)**
```
Narine, 41-year-old Armenian woman, light olive skin with warm undertone, oval face with defined cheekbones, strong dark natural eyebrows, dark brown slightly hooded almond eyes with faint under-eye shadows, tired but sharp and attentive gaze, straight nose with a slight bridge bump, fine lines at the eye corners and a faint forehead line, small mole on her left cheekbone, shoulder-length dark brown almost-black hair with a few grey strands at the right temple, worn in a loose low clip with face-framing strands, thin silver hoop earrings, average height, slim-average build, minimal makeup
```

**B. Wardrobe block (default office look)**
```
navy merino crew-neck cardigan over an ivory button-up blouse, charcoal straight-leg wool-blend trousers, black leather low block-heel loafers, slim watch with brown leather strap on left wrist, tortoiseshell rectangular reading glasses hooked on the blouse placket, company ID badge on a dark grey lanyard
```

**1. Full-body turnaround (master sheet)**
```
Character reference sheet, full-body turnaround of [A], wearing [B]. Four views side by side on one sheet: front, three-quarter, side profile, back. Neutral standing pose, arms relaxed, same scale and same eye level in every view. Plain light-grey seamless studio background, soft even diffused lighting, no shadows on background. Photorealistic, natural skin texture with visible pores, realistic fabric texture. Clean layout, no text, no labels.
```

**2. Expression sheet**
```
Character expression sheet of [A], wearing the navy cardigan and ivory blouse. 3x2 grid of head-and-shoulders portraits, same framing, same lighting, same hair: (1) neutral, (2) focused, reading closely with a slight frown, (3) tired small smile, (4) skeptical, one eyebrow slightly raised, (5) quietly amused, (6) exhausted, rubbing the bridge of her nose. Plain light-grey background, soft studio light, 85mm portrait lens look, photorealistic, no text.
```

**3. Face close-up (the face reference for all scene shots)**
```
Close-up portrait of [A], front-facing, looking straight into the camera, neutral expression with a tired but sharp gaze. Soft window light from the left, plain light-grey background, 85mm lens, f/4, sharp focus on the eyes, natural skin texture, no retouching, no glasses on face. Photorealistic.
```

**4. Props sheet**
```
Flat-lay product-style reference sheet of Narine's belongings on a light-grey surface: tortoiseshell rectangular reading glasses, slim watch with brown leather strap, company ID badge on dark grey lanyard, thin silver hoop earrings, worn black leather tote bag, a dog-eared English-Armenian dictionary, a printed document covered in red-pen edits, a mid-range laptop with sticky notes on the lid, a ceramic mug of black coffee. Top-down, even lighting, photorealistic, no text, no logos.
```

**5. Scene template + example**
```
[SHOT TYPE + ANGLE] of [A], wearing [B], [ACTION], in [LOCATION], [TIME OF DAY + LIGHTING]. 2026 office: modern open-plan, ultrawide monitors, laptops, wireless headsets. Photorealistic, natural skin texture, [LENS] look, muted realistic color grade.
```
```
Medium shot from a slightly high angle of [A], wearing [B], reading glasses now on her face, comparing a printed contract against a translation on her ultrawide monitor, pen in hand, in a modern open-plan office in Yerevan, late afternoon, warm low sun through the blinds mixed with cool monitor light. 2026 office: laptops, wireless headsets, a half-finished coffee. Photorealistic, natural skin texture, 50mm lens look, muted realistic color grade.
```

**Wardrobe variants (replace [B] with one of these only when the story needs it)**
- Commute: [B] plus a long camel wool coat and a dark green wool scarf.
- Client meeting: charcoal blazer over the ivory blouse, charcoal trousers, black loafers, same watch and earrings, glasses in hand.
- Home, evening: grey oversized knit sweater, dark jeans, hair down, glasses on, earrings removed.

**Negative prompt**
```
young, smooth airbrushed skin, heavy makeup, glamour pose, fashion model, blonde, light-colored eyes, different hairstyle, bangs, cartoon, anime, 3D render, illustration, extra fingers, deformed hands, text, watermark, logo
```

**Settings**
- **Midjourney v7:**
  - Sheets 1, 2 and 4: `--ar 16:9 --style raw --stylize 50`
  - Close-up 3: `--ar 4:5 --style raw --stylize 50`
  - Scene shots: add `--oref <close-up URL> --ow 100`. Raise `--ow` to 150–250 for a stronger face match, or lower it if the outfit in the reference keeps carrying over.
  - Keep one fixed `--seed` while you make the sheets.
- **Flux / SDXL:**
  - Size: 1536×864 for the sheets, 1024×1280 for the close-up.
  - CFG about 3.5 for Flux or 5–6 for SDXL, 30–40 steps, fixed seed.
  - For scene shots, use PuLID or IP-Adapter FaceID with the close-up at weight 0.7–0.85.
  - For a long series, train a LoRA on 15–25 of the best images from sheets 1–3.
- **GPT-Image / Gemini:** attach the close-up and the turnaround as reference images. Start the prompt with: *"Same woman as in the reference images. Keep her face, hair, mole and earrings exactly the same."*

**Check every image for these:** mole on the left cheekbone, grey strands at the right temple, silver hoops, watch on the left wrist, slight bump on the nose. Reject any image that makes her look younger or glamorous. Generate at least 4 options per shot and keep the one that best matches the close-up.
